Senior Product Manager (m/f/d)

- Full Time
- Tauentzienstraße 14, 10789 Berlin, Germany
- With Professional Experience
- 7/10/26

About softgarden

At softgarden, we build software that helps companies hire better and faster. Our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) is one of the leading platforms in the German-speaking market and is used every day by recruiters and hiring teams to screen applications, review candidates, and make hiring decisions.

We're currently doubling down on AI to reshape both how our customers hire and how we build software internally. Today, anyone in our product organization can already go from idea to production using natural language, with engineering review ensuring quality. But we’re just getting started, and there’s a huge opportunity to take this to the next level.

That's where you come in.

Your role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) to take ownership of a core area of our ATS - the product hiring teams rely on every day. You'll define the vision, set the bar for what great looks like, and lead a fully staffed cross-functional team of engineers, designers, QAs, and tech leads to ship outcomes that move the business.

This role reports to the Director Product. You'll have the mandate to make decisions, the autonomy to set direction, and the responsibility to deliver measurable impact.

What You'll Do:

- Own a core product area end-to-end. Set the vision, define the roadmap, and drive execution. Success is measured by impact, not output.
- Prototype and build, don't just specify. You won’t stop at requirements. When it creates leverage, you’ll use AI‑powered tools to prototype, test, and sometimes ship code to production with engineering review. You step in where needed to move faster and learn quicker.
- Drive customer impact: Use insights, analytics, and experimentation to build ATS features that make hiring workflows faster, easier, and more enjoyable for recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates.
- Stay close to users & data: Collaborate with marketing and sales to understand current and future customer needs and turn insights into actionable improvements.
- Lead complex delivery at pace: Structure ambiguous problems, align stakeholders across multiple products and teams, and keep a large cross-functional team focused, coordinated, and moving at pace.
- Collaborate & influence: Align product, design, engineering, marketing, and commercial stakeholders on strategy and execution.

What you bring along

- 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, with a clear track record of shipping products that moved metrics, not just shipped features.
- Hands-on experience shipping AI-powered features to customers. You're fluent with AI-powered prototyping and product-building tools, and you've shipped AI-powered features to customers.
- Proven ability to lead large cross-functional teams (engineers, designers, QAs, tech leads) and align strategy and execution across business functions.
- Strong analytical and structured thinking. You break down complex workflows, edge cases, and dependencies into clear priorities and well-reasoned decisions.
- A bias for action. You're pragmatic, decisive, and create momentum in ambiguity.
- A agile mindset: you adapt process to fit team, product, and business context, and you don't confuse following a framework with making progress.
- Experience in HR Tech or recruiting software - and a solid understanding of what it means to build for German SMBs - is a strong plus.
- Fluent in English - German is a plus: You communicate clearly with teams, stakeholders, and customers, and are comfortable joining direct customer conversations to understand needs and feedback.

Why softgarden?

Coffee and free food in the office are amazing and yes, we do have those. But let's be honest, that is not what really matters. At softgarden we strive to live an open company culture, where ...

- You work on a meaningful product with real impact on how companies hire
- Product teams have real ownership, trust, and room to shape how we work
- The leadership team is serious about AI - not as a buzzword, but as a shift in how we work together and build software
- Work moves around your personal life and not the other way around
- Fair communication and feedback, practiced not just preached
- You are trusted with flexible working hours, home office and remote work options

But of course, we also have the other benefits, too ...

- Public transportation ticket or a job bike
- Company pension plan
- Access to corporate benefits
- 30 days of vacation with a 5-day week
- Discounted Wellpass membership
- A present for your birthday and company anniversary
- Modern hardware (Mac or Windows - your choice)
- Team events, such as our summer party, free lunches, and after-work drinks
- A great, central office in Berlin near the zoo

If you’re looking for a product role with impact, autonomy, and technical ambition, we’d like to hear from you.

Tom Kleinschmidt

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

You start your day aligning with senior stakeholders in Gas Services on key priorities and communication needs. From there, you refine leadership messages and develop clear storylines for strategic and operational topics.

Throughout the day, you translate complex content into concise, impactful communication, collaborate with colleagues to sharpen ideas, and independently manage communication projects in an international environment supporting transformation and change.

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Leadership and executive communications for Gas Services, including development of clear, impactful messaging for senior stakeholders
* Development, structuring, and refinement of strategic, operational, and transformation-related communication content and storylines
* Translation of complex topics into clear, audience-specific messages with strong focus on tone, context, and impact
* Independent management of communication projects in a global, international environment, including close collaboration with senior stakeholders
* Active contribution to internal communication, storytelling formats, and change and transformation initiatives
* Collaboration within cross-functional teams to challenge, refine, and improve communication outputs and ideas

What You Bring
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Media Studies or a related field, or equivalent experience in a professional communications environment
* Full professional proficiency in German and English, both written and spoken
* Proven experience in internal or corporate communications or comparable communication-focused roles
* Strong writing, structuring, and storytelling skills with the ability to translate complex topics into clear and concise messages
* Confidence and professionalism in working with senior stakeholders in an international and diverse environment
* Structured, independent, and reliable working style with strong ownership and execution capability
* Strong curiosity and ability to quickly understand new topics and adapt communication to different audiences and contexts 

About the Team

Our Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 
* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

Siemens Energy is an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. jobs.occupation: Systems Engineer Satellite Operations (m/f/d) (Ingenieur/in - Systems Engineering)
jobs.description:
Your Tasks

At OHB, we take on some of the most exciting challenges in the space industry. We work across a wide spectrum of spacecraft missions — from single satellites to entire constellations, from LEO to interplanetary exploration, supporting customers in Defence, Science, and beyond.

In our Spacecraft Operations Development team, we want to shape the operational concept from day one. We collaborate closely with customers, write the user manuals for the satellites we deliver, develop the flight procedures that will guide operations in orbit, and support the mission from separation through handover — and often long after.

We’re now looking for a passionate and experienced Spacecraft Operations Engineer who’s ready to jump in, get up to speed quickly, and contribute from proposals all the way through Phase E.

If you have hands-on experience creating and validating procedures, if you’ve been part of LEOP and commissioning campaigns, and if you’re excited about influencing earlier mission phases to enable simple, reliable, and robust operations for our customers — we’d love to meet you.
This is your opportunity to leave a meaningful mark on space.
Your Qualifications

Required

- Degree in Aerospace Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a similar technical field.
- 7+ years of experience in Spacecraft Operations Development, such as writing or validating flight procedures, developing operations concepts, creating spacecraft user manuals o supporting pre‑launch and in‑orbit preparation
- Hands-on experience in LEOP and Commissioning (actively participating in real-time ops).
- Strong understanding of spacecraft subsystems (AOCS, Power, TT&C, Thermal, Payload, etc.).
- Experience with Mission Control Systems and ground segment tools (e.g., SCOS‑2000, EGS‑CC, MCS look-alikes, automation frameworks).
- Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Preferred / Nice to have

- Professional proficiency in German (spoken and written).
- Experience supporting phases B/C/D, especially requirements definition, design reviews, and operations preparation.
- Experience with constellations, on‑board automation, or autonomy concepts.
- Understanding of ECSS standards, especially related to operations (E‑70 series).
Experience with simulator testing, procedure automation (e.g., TM/TC scripting), FMECA / hazard analysis from an ops perspective
- Familiarity with project management tools and workflows (e.g., JIRA, Confluence).
- Ability to work in customer‑oriented environments (ESA, DLR, defence customers, commercial operators).

Soft Skills (important for the role)

- Strong communication and documentation skills.
- Ability to collaborate with system engineers, AIV teams, and customers.
- Proactive, structured, and able to work independently.
- Problem‑solving mindset, especially under time pressure (LEOP, anomalies).
- Willingness to occasionally travel for reviews, test campaigns, or operations.

Your Tasks

- Creation and refinement of technical concepts, requirements and software architecture
- Development, implementation and test of the simulators
- Supporting technical reviews and support project milestone reviews
- Coordination with customers and internal software teams for the design, for reviews and the timely delivery of simulators
Your Qualifications

- Degree in computer science, aerospace engineering, electrical engineering or comparable qualification
- Ideally previous experience as software architect/technical lead in larger software projects (e.g. automotive, aerospace, scientific computing or gaming)
- Experience with distributed simulation frameworks (HLA), and with system-of-systems simulation is a plus
- Experience with development and simulation of networks and communication systems and related protocols/technologies is a plus
- Proficiency in modern C++ (or similar languages)
- Experience with applicable NATO standards and processes, and/or knowledge of related process standards from adjacent fields (such as ECSS-E-ST-40C and ECSS-Q-ST-80C or DO‑178C) would be an advantage
- Strong competence in self-organizing and work planning
- High motivation, pro-active working approach, and strong sense of responsibility
- Strong competence in working in a multicultural team

**3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d) **

Senckenberg Society for Nature Research (SGN), headquartered in Frankfurt am Main, is seeking to fill the following two positions in the Department of Palaeontology & Historical Geology and the Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology at the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt, starting as of 01 January 2027

3D Imaging Specialist – Collection Digitisation (m/f/d)

(full time / part time)

Location: Frankfurt (Hesse)

Organizational units:

Department of Palaeontology & Historlcal Geology, Section Amber Research

Department of Messel Research and Paleobiology, Section Palaeomammalogy

Department of Palaeoanthropology, Section Mammalogy

Employment scope: Full-time / Part-time

Type of contract: Project-based, fixed-term for three years

Remuneration: Collective agreement of Hesse, TV-H E 9

The Senckenberg Society for Nature Research is a member of the Leibniz Association and has been investigating the “Earth System” worldwide for more than 200 years, examining the past, analysing the present, and developing projections for the future. We conduct integrative geobiodiversity research with the aim of understanding nature in all its complexity and diversity in order to preserve it as the foundation of life for future generations and to ensure its sustainable use. Across eight institutes and five research stations throughout Germany, scientists from more than 40 countries conduct research at the highest international level.

The city of Frankfurt, where the Senckenberg Society was originally founded, hosts the organization’s central administrative services along with two research institutes housing extensive scientific collections and one of Senckenberg’s most renowned institutions, the Senckenberg Natural History Museum Frankfurt. Senckenberg is as much a part of the city’s identity as its skyline and its traditional apple wine.

Within the framework of the project "SCRE3NED: Senckenberg Collection's RarEst – 3-dimensioNal Enhanced Digitisation", type specimens of exceptional scientific value (holotypes, paratypes and lectotypes) from various collections of the Senckenberg Research Institute and Natural History Museum Frankfurt (amber, extant and fossil mammals, Messel fossils) are digitised using micro-computed tomography (μCT), synchrotron radiation-based micro-computed tomography (SRμCT), and digital photography. The aim is to produce high-quality, standardised and FAIR-compliant 2D and 3D datasets for research, collection management and science communication.

Your tasks

- Performing and documenting μCT scans in accordance with established quality standards
- Supporting the preparation and execution of SRμCT scanning campaigns at external research facilities
- Reconstruction, segmentation and quality control of 3D image datasets
- Contributing to the implementation of photography-based digitisation methods
- Creation, maintenance and management of metadata in accordance with the FAIR principles
- Preparation and integration of digital datasets into the collection databases (DINA, SeSam/AQUiLA)
- Further development, optimisation and standardisation of workflows for the 3D digitisation of a range of different object groups
- Ensuring consistent data and file organisation as well as long-term archiving
- Collaboration with curators, scientists, IT specialists and external project partners

Your profile

- Completed vocational training in a technical or scientific field (e.g., technical assistant for natural history museums and research institutes, biological or medical laboratory technician, photographic technical assistant, preparator) or a completed university degree (Bachelor's/Master's) in biology, earth sciences, medical engineering, computer science, engineering, media technology or a related field, or a comparable qualification with relevant professional experience
- Practical experience with imaging techniques, preferably computed tomography
- Confident use of software for 3D image processing and segmentation (e.g., Avizo/Amira, VGStudio MAX, Dragonfly, 3D Slicer).
- Good IT skills and a willingness to familiarise yourself with new software environments
- Knowledge of digital data management and data organisation
- Careful and responsible handling of unique and sometimes fragile objects
- Valid category B driving licence
- A structured, independent and solution-oriented approach to work, combined with the ability to work well in a team
- Good written and spoken German and English

Desirable skills

- Experience in operating and working with computed tomography systems
- Knowledge of 3D printing techniques and of preparing models for printing
- Experience with photography-based digitisation methods, in particular photogrammetry
- Familiarity with the FAIR principles and experience with repositories for 3D data (e.g., MorphoSource) or with collection databases
- Interest in natural history collections, biodiversity research and digitisation
- Basic knowledge of vertebrate and insect morphology
